title: Skillora
summary: Free learning paths for any skill. Gemini drafts a course, an admin checks it, and learners go module by module: YouTube lessons, quizzes, a final exam and a certificate anyone can verify.
detail: Gemini only returns search queries, never URLs, so the app can't ship made-up links. Who can edit, publish or take an exam is decided by Cerbos policies, not if-statements in routes.

title: AptIQ
summary: Aptitude prep for engineering students: courses by topic, timed and proctored tests, and a leaderboard. Built with a team from colleges in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.
detail: Frontend and API live in separate repos. Tests watch for tab switches, and results feed a per-section accuracy chart.

title: MediDiagnose
summary: Predicts the risk of 12 diseases at once from symptoms, lab values and age. Compares logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost, and shows why each prediction was made.
detail: Multi-label, so it can flag diabetes and hypertension together. SHAP and LIME explain each result; a Flask dashboard plots them with Chart.js. For learning only, not medical advice.

title: TenderAI India
summary: Upload a government tender PDF and get an eligibility, technical and financial check, a score, a 170-item compliance matrix and a first draft of the bid.
detail: JWT auth with vendor and admin roles, bcrypt passwords, PDFs stored on disk with the extracted text in MongoDB. Web Technology course project.

title: AI Bot Coder
summary: A coding assistant that runs from a USB stick. Plug it in, double-click start.bat, chat in the browser. No internet, no install, no admin rights.
detail: Qwen2.5-3B fine-tuned with QLoRA for code answers, served by llama.cpp on the CPU. Falls back to a smaller model on low-RAM PCs.

title: Hospital Shortage Early Warning
summary: Datathon prototype. When a patient is admitted, it predicts whether the hospital is heading into a bed, ICU or staff shortage (low / medium / high) and explains why.
detail: Trained on 200,000 admissions from 50 hospitals over 24 months. SHAP explains each prediction.

title: CS Odyssey
summary: Explore a 3D motherboard part by part, then read where each part of computing is heading next.

title: NavaDhiti Code Review
summary: Paste code in any of eight languages and Gemini sorts the feedback into bugs, improvements and style, with a score out of 10.

title: RYVONEXA '26 Registration
summary: Registration for our department's national symposium: pick events, add teammates, get an entry pass with a QR code. The desk can search entries and export them to CSV.

title: Sudarsanam Driving School
summary: Website for a driving school in Sivakasi: courses, fees and enquiries.

title: Sri Balaji Agency
summary: Catalogue site for an industrial supplies shop in Sivakasi.

title: The Evolution of AI
summary: A scrolling history of AI from Turing's 1950 paper to today, one era per section.

title: The Spice Cart
summary: A menu card for a restaurant that works well on phones.

title: Login with Supabase
summary: Register, log in and see a dashboard, with users stored in Supabase Postgres.

title: Book Haven
summary: A static four-page bookstore: home, catalogue, login and register.
